title: Croatian Gibanica Bread
description: A delicious Croatian-inspired bread filled with the flavors of gibanica, a traditional Croatian cheese pie. Perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together yeast and 50ml of warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine gibanica, sugar, salt, and butter. Mix well.
Add the yeast mixture to the gibanica mixture and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong shape.
Place the dough in the prepared baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
